verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs autonomously in the background, reviewing every PR update automatically and posting inline comments. Users can steer it with `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` rules, natural-language effort settings, and org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, and a community user confirms auto-reviews run by default. However, the only automation it offers is PR review, so users cannot define their own background tasks. Missing for 10: user-defined automations beyond PR review, custom triggers or schedules (only PR events and comment commands are documented), and independent evidence of building automations in Bugbot Automations.
